Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR REPAIR/MAINT OF ACCESSORIES OF AC PLANT INSTALLED AT AF STN JA MNAGAR 1. Custom Bid for Supply/Job work has been uploaded/ issued in GeM portal .You are requested to quote your reasonable rate for the same within the bid submission end date. 2. Your rates should be inclusive for the free delivery/repair/replacement amend ment of works and the various taxes including GST. 3. Bids received will be opened by the buyer at office of the GE (AF) Jamnagar N o 1. Technical evaluation of bid will be done as per the conditions and various docu ments required as mentioned in ATC. Non observance of those conditions may mak e your bid invalid and unacceptable. SPECIFIC CONDITIONS 1. Old retrieved materials will be the property of the vendor as schedule of credi t already detected. 2. The work should be guaranteed for one year after completion of the works/ re pairs. 3. After award of the job work/repair should be done immediately but not later t hen the date fixed in the contract. 4 Rates should be offered as per specification of description mentioned in Scope of Work. 5. Rate should be inclusive of all contingencies. Rates should be of delivery at site of AGE E/M No-I under Garrison Engineer (AF) Jamnagar No 1 PIN-361003. 6. Garrison Engineer (AF) Jamnagar No. 01 reserves the right of accepting or reje cting of quotation without assessment and reasons thereof. 7. On receipt of order to carry out the works/ repairs, if you fail to comple te work, in accordance with the above conditions GE (AF) Jamnagar No 1 reserves t he right to carry out the same elsewhere or by other agency under your risk and co st.

8. If the work as shown in conditions above cannot be carried out, you should give alternative date for completion of the repairs. 9. The department reserves the right to cancel your agreement as and when y our services seem to be unsatisfactory. 10. The firm will carry out the Job Work / delivery of items in site located at AGE E/M No-I of GE (AF) Jamnagar No. 01. 11. The rates quoted and accepted are for receipt, installation and Job Work in acc ordance with conditions 2 and 3 mentioned above loading in to public carries/repaire rs vehicles or unloading from public carrier/repairers vehicles or unloading from publ ic carrier/repairers vehicle at the consignee’s and shall be sent by the department re pairer at its own cost. 12. All stores required for Job Work be provided by the firm at his own cost and h is rates shall be deemed to include the cost therein. 13. The firm will provide all material/spares required for the testing of the item or dered and his rates would be deemed to include the cost thereof. 14. The firm shall only be the custodian of the items handed over to it for Job Work while ownership and all other rights on the item is of the department. 15. If the Job Work is excepted to be delayed due to any cause beyond your co ntrol, you shall immediately on the happening of the event causing delay in Job Work give notice thereof in writing to the accepting officer under intimation to the consign ee who after consideration of circumstances causing delay in the repairs may grant r easonable extension of time for completing Job Work. 16. In case the Job Work is not completed within the stipulated time the order may be cancelled and the items taken back without any liability, what so ever towar ds the department. 17. Payment will be made to Supplier/Firm only after satisfactory completion of Job Work and submission of bill pre-audited and passed for payment. 18. The supplied Stores/items should be guaranteed against/manufacturing defec ts for a period of one year from the date of supply. The supplier undertakes to repa ir/replace the defective items up to the period specified as above. 19. The Supplier/ firm shall contact Engineer-in-Charge for the purpose of inspect ion of site and relevant documents. The Supplier/firm shall also make himself familiar with working conditions, accessibility of site, availability of materials and other coge nt conditions which may affect the completion of work. The Supplier/firm shall be de emed to have visited the site and made himself familiar with working conditions whe ther he actually inspect the site or not. 20. Registration / Empanelment Requirement : Contract shall be awarded to only s uch sellers, who are registered / empanelled / approved/ enlisted/ working experienc e with MES for the required goods / service category on the date of bid opening. Pros pective bidders (if not already registered), are advised to get themselves registered with the said registration authority before bid opening date. (It is certified that the re gistration is granted by the registering agency as per Rule 150 of GFR following a fair , transparent and reasonable procedure. 21. Garrison Engineer (AF) Jamnagar No 1 or his authorized representative Board s of officers will inspect the Works/ Repair done by you and his findings will be final f or acceptance. 22. You or your representative must be present at the time of inspection of job wo rks/ repairs carried out by you. 23. EMPLOYEES PROVIDENT FUND (a) The contractor shall have provident fund code number. Any sub-contractor engaged by him shouldalso have provident fund code number. (b) The contractor shall ensure that all the workers deployed during the ex ecution of work are enrolled as members of provident fund and should be give

n the Universal Account Number (UAN). The contractor shall submit relevant p articulars to the GE on asked for. (c) While claiming any payment, the contractor shall submit the certificate that all workers employed directly or indirectly by him are registered for EPF a nd due contributions have been credited into their account. 24. SECURITY AND PASSES 24.1 Refer Condition 25 of IAFW-2249. The contractor shall employ only Indian Nat ionals as his representatives, servants and workmen and verify their antecede nts and loyalty before employing them for the works. He shall ensure that no p erson of doubtful antecedents and nationality is in any way, associated with w ork. If for reasons of technical collaboration or other consideration, the employ ment of any foreign national is unavoidable, the contractor shall furnish full pa rticulars of this effect to the Accepting Officer at the time of submission of his t ender. 24.2 The contractor shall, on demand by the Engineer-in-Charge, submit list of his agents, employees and work people concerned and shall satisfy the Engineer-i n-Charge as to the bonafides of such people 24.3 The Engineer-in-Charge shall at his discretion have the right to issue passes a s per rules and regulations of the installation/area in force to control the admis sion of the contractor, his agents, employees and work people to the site of th e work or any part thereof. Passes should be returned at any time on demand by the Engineer-in-Charge of the authorities concerned and in any case on com pletion of work. 24.4 The contractor and his agents, employees and work people shall observe all t he rules promulgated by the authority controlling the installation/area in which the work is to be carried out e.g. prohibition of smoking and lighting, fire preca utions, search of persons on entry and exit, keeping to specific routes, observi ng specified timing etc. Nothing extra shall be admissible for any hours etc, lo st on this account. 25. Identity cards or passes The contractor, his agents and representative are required individually to be in possession of any identity cards or pass duly verified by the Garrison Engineer. The security staff will examine the identity card or pass at the time of entry i nto, exit from the Restricted Area and also at any time or number of times insi de the Restricted Area. 25.1 Identity of workmen Every workman shall be in possession of an identity card. The identity card w ill be issued after through investigation of the antecedents of the labourers by the contractors and attested by the Officer–in-Charge of the unit concerned in accordance with the standing rules and regulations of the units. Contractor sha ll be responsible for the conduct and action of his workmen, agents or represe ntatives. 25.2 Search Through search of all persons and transport shall be carried out at each gate a nd for as many times as gate is used for entry or exit and may also be carried out at any time or any number of times at the work site within the Restricted A

rea. 26. STANDARD AND QUALITY OF WORK The entire electrical work under this contract shall be carried out in strict comp liance with these specifications and inconformity with the provisions contained the latest Edition (including amendments) of Indian Electricity Supply Act 1948 and Indian Electricity Rules 1948 as amplified and enforced by the Gujrat State Government. All electrical works shall be carried out by properly skilled electri cians under supervision of suitable qualified supervisors. As per latest practice and latest IS code / IS Rules. The contractor shall produced such evidence of q ualification of his workman / supervisor either at commencement of work / or a t any time there after on demand by Engineer-in-Charge. Approval of samples shall be in writing. Approved sample shall be labeled as such signed by both th e contractor and Engineer-In-Charge and kept in the custody of the Enginer-In- Charge till the completion of the work. 27. REPAIR OR REPLACEMENT GENERALLY: Repair/replacement shall generally include,(a) disconnecting (b) dismantling of parts,(c) carrying out repairs specified ,and / or replacement, (d) overhaulin g by cleaning and oiling or greasing, re-assembling of units,(e) initial testing b efore fixing,(f) refixing of equipments at the position including cleaning and ne cessary repairs to base / position,(g) replacement of bolts, nuts as required,(h) any all other petty works essential for smooth working of equipment and (j) tes ting of equipment at full load. All these operation shall be carried out as direct ed by Engineer-in-Charge and to his entire satisfaction. 27.1 Taking out and dismantling of parts of equipment should be done using prope r tools and with special care. Any damage caused due to mishandling of the eq uipment will be made good by the contractor without any extra payment. 27.2 The rate quoted by the tenderer in Sch ‘A’ shall be deemed to included minor repairs such as fixing of screws (any type),welding of sheet polishing, denting etc. If required to be carried out to complete the work. PAYMENT INSTRUCTIONS 1. Payment shall be made on completion of the job works/repairs by the authori zed representative detailed by the consignee or his superior HQ. 2. On completion of job works/Repairs, the vendor will be required to submit his invoice. Payment will be made through CMP Fund Transfer hence it is requested to submit your Bank Account details in case it is necessary. 3. Copy of the contract order will be attached with the bill. 4. Where GST in charged, the vendor will quote his GST Registration Number. 5. Payment will be made to the vendor account by CMP Fund Transfer. 6. The quoted rate should include all the taxes including GST. DOCUMENTS TO BE UPLOADED FOR TECHNICAL EVALUATION 1. Copy of registered / empanelled / approved/ enlisted with MES for the re quired goods / service category on the date of bid opening. Prospective bidders (if not already registered), are advised to get themselves registered with the sa id registration authority. (It is certified that the registration is granted by the re gistering agency as per Rule 150 of GFR following a fair, transparent and reaso

nable procedure. 2. Compliance of Scope of Work and Terms & Condition duly signed and stampe d by the bidder. 3. MSME Registration certificate. 4. Copy of Registration with MES. 5. Certificate of MII. 6. The Affidavit must not be older than Ten months on Stamp Paper for Non Bla ck Listing/ bankrupted of the firm by any Govt Department. .
